hypotheses.persona: Single professional working regular office hours
hypotheses.rationale: The weekend observations show a consistent pattern where object_16 remains at home throughout both Saturday and Sunday, contrasting with weekday departures. This strongly supports the professional work hypothesis with distinct weekend behavior.
The structured weekday pattern and now consistent weekend behavior make this highly unlikely. A student would likely show more variability in their schedule.
The clear distinction between weekday and weekend patterns makes remote work extremely unlikely, as remote workers typically maintain more consistent schedules across days.
